scoring_justification: The CO2RR limiting potential UL_CO2 cannot be fully recomputed from the supplied artifacts alone (lacks H2O energy), but UL_H2 is recomputable from raw total energies, and the main selectivity trend (UL_diff) can be checked on the reported values. T1 recompute is infeasible for the full descriptor; hence T3 structural trend scoring supplemented by a consistency recompute on UL_H2 is used.

outputs.description: Free-energy analysis for N-C and Ni-N-C catalysts; total energies and derived limiting potentials. The checker recomputes free energies from total energies and verifies that UL_diff(Ni-N-C) > UL_diff(N-C) by at least 0.05 eV (selectivity trend). Energies in eV; UL values in V.

steps.description: Recompute the HER limiting potential UL_H2 from the raw total energies (clean, *H, H2) using standard CHE corrections; verify that the agent's reported UL_H2 matches the recomputed value within 0.01 V for both catalysts. A deviation indicates inconsistency.
Verify that UL_diff(Ni-N-C) > UL_diff(N-C) + 0.05 V. The larger, more positive UL_diff for Ni-N-C is the paper's central DFT selectivity claim.
